heroes_0 = df0[['name']].drop_duplicates()
heroes_1 = df1[['hero_names']].drop_duplicates().rename(columns={'hero_names': 'name'})

# Union hero names from both sources
all_heroes = pd.concat([heroes_0, heroes_1], ignore_index=True).drop_duplicates()

# Join all heroes with df0 to get Publisher info
merged = pd.merge(all_heroes, df0[['name', 'Publisher']], on='name', how='left')

# Drop rows with missing Publisher (heroes not in df0)
merged = merged.dropna(subset=['Publisher'])

# Group by Publisher string, count heroes per publisher
publisher_counts = merged.groupby('Publisher').size().reset_index(name='hero_count')

# Map Publisher string to integer IDs (1-based), sorted alphabetically by Publisher name
publisher_counts = publisher_counts.sort_values('Publisher').reset_index(drop=True)
publisher_counts['Publisher_ID'] = publisher_counts.index + 1

# Output only the Publisher_ID column as integer, rename to 'Publisher'
result = publisher_counts[['Publisher_ID']].rename(columns={'Publisher_ID': 'Publisher'})

# Write the result to the specified path
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_96/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
